_about: Ground truth for real IndustryBuying product pages captured 2026-10-14 via the owner's Chrome (fetch, credentials omitted, browser UA). Established by reading the raw HTML (JSON-LD + server-rendered price block text) independently of rtech_sync.parsers. All prices INR. On every page the main price block reads '<incl> (Incl. of all taxes) <excl> + 18% GST [MRP <mrp> <n>% OFF]'; JSON-LD Product.offers.price equals the INCL-GST figure. IB's displayed excl figure is not always exactly incl/1.18 (finolex 124 vs 104, anchor 420 vs 360), so never derive one from the other.

fixtures.variant_description: Polycab Optima+ 1.5 Sq.mm 1 Core FRLF Wire Red (90 m); SKU EL.CA.HO.HA.169562
fixtures.notes: No MRP shown. JSON-LD availability InStock; 'Ships within 3 days'. Page has FAMILY_ATTRIBUTES swatches (Color x5, Nominal Area x8) and an 'EXPLORE OTHER VARIANTS' list (38 more) with sibling prices, e.g. 0.75 Sq.mm Yellow ₹9,439 - each variant is its own URL/SKU, so this URL is single-variant. Related-product prices ('₹943 ₹2,900 Add to Cart') precede the main price in document text.

fixtures.variant_description: Polycab Optima+ 2.5 Sq.mm 1 Core FRLF Wire Black (90 m); SKU EL.CA.HO.HA.169587
fixtures.notes: Swatch 'selected' SKUs point to representative siblings (Black->169585, 2.5 Sq.mm->169579), NOT this page's SKU 169587: do not use swatch SKUs as the page identity. JSON-LD sku is authoritative.
